topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Imagine the surprise when I learned my college application essay had been selected to inspire others. At first, a rush of nervous flutterings danced in my chest. Then, a warm glow spread, thinking of how my words might help a fellow dreamer find their path. It felt like a quiet nod from the universe, a reminder that the words we pour into the world can take on a life of their own, touching hearts and minds in ways we never expected. I smiled, hoping my story would light a tiny spark in someone else's journey, just as so many others had done for me.
